svg.title: Canary rollout of zhenxi0901's contributions
svg.desc: Li ZhenXi's last year of GitHub contributions (1,982), shown as a canary rollout: each week starts on a dim old version and switches to its real colour in stages of 1%, 5%, 25%, 50% and 100% of the weeks, while a traffic bar fills up, ending with the stamp 'rollout complete · healthy'. Live health of the portfolio site: p95 0.8 ms, 99.99% up, commit 8a96ca9.
